Step 4 — Operationalize
Add the search to a dashboard or set up alert actions (email, webhook, PagerDuty, etc.) as required. Document the use case in your runbook and assign an owner. Consider visualizations: Timechart (actual vs predicted spend), Table (anomaly details), Single value (current anomaly count), Alert indicator (anomaly detected).
